record.question: What does "right to information" mean under Section 2(j) of the RTI Act, 2005?
options: The right to access personal information of any individual
The right to obtain information from private organizations

The right to information accessible under the Act, held by or under the control of any public authority, including the rights to inspect work, documents, records; take notes, extracts or certified copies; take certified samples of material; and obtain information in electronic form.
The right to question public authorities in a court of law
record.explanation: Third party includes any person other than the requester, including a public authority.
